name: greenfield with an unresolved has_ui — STRATEGY halts before the loop can start
why: The tri-state `has_ui` is the field that erased E2E for a whole run, silently, with no ledger entry: written as `NOT has_ui`, the GATE_A guard matched `null` as if it were `false`. It used to be caught 200 lines later by a dedicated halt edge at GATE_A (12d), tested BEFORE the two real exits, which also needed its own agent itinerary, its own nodes.md callout, its own diagram caveat and its own spec check. It is now caught where the value is settled: STRATEGY already asks the user for every other run-level setting, and edge 6 refuses to leave without a real boolean. This walk is what proves the halt survived the move — the run stops before BRANCH, so no branch, no agent and no gate is ever reached with an unroutable field. The halt names BOTH of STRATEGY's exits as tested, because a zero-match halt has a set of guards that all failed, not one.
